detail: Field-test hardening of boot recipe inference. Sinatra gets a recipe row: rackup for a config.ru repo, ruby app.rb for a classic app, abstention otherwise. Spring wrappers committed without their exec bit (git mode 100644, a common upstream defect that exits 126) run through sh. The exited-before-serving message now names --exec as the fix path alongside --target. Proven live by OSS field tests: bezkoder/spring-boot-h2-database-crud enriched 7 of 7 operations through sh ./mvnw after the bare wrapper failed, and JoeDiTrolio/DotNet-8-Crud-Web-API-Example proved the dotnet row 3 of 5 zero-config.
